verdict.rationale: A dedicated 'discover website URLs' guide says Context.dev can map all of a site's URLs from its own index, with page titles, descriptions, keywords and languages. It can also read a site's public sitemaps and return a filtered URL list without rendering each page, which is URL discovery without a full crawl. Missing for 10: evidence of speed or latency backing 'instantly', coverage or limit details for the map, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
